question_text: Juan, a 67-year-old natural-born Filipino citizen, has been living abroad for the past 15 years. He wishes to vote in the upcoming Philippine national elections. Which of the following statements best describes his eligibility to vote?

options.text: He is disqualified because he is over 65 years old.
He is disqualified because he has not resided in the Philippines for at least one year immediately preceding the election.
He is qualified to vote as long as he registers as an overseas voter and meets the residency requirement for overseas Filipinos.
He is qualified to vote only if he returns to the Philippines and resides here for at least six months before the election.
